Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Remove fallen leaves and infected fruit. Spray a protectant fungicide (captan/mancozeb or sulfur) at bud break and repeat per label.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Rake and destroy leaf litter in autumn; prune for airflow; plant resistant varieties.

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune out cankers and mummified fruit. Apply a labelled fungicide during the growing season.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitise pruning tools; remove dead wood; avoid wounding trees.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply a fungicide (myclobutanil or sulfur) from pink bud through petal fall.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby juniper/cedar hosts if possible; choose rust-resistant varieties.

Apple___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Blueberry___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray sulfur or a labelled fungicide; prune infected shoots.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Improve canopy airflow; avoid excess nitrogen; irrigate in the morning.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply a foliar fungicide if disease reaches the upper leaves before tasseling.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Rotate crops, till residue, and plant resistant hybrids.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Usually minor; apply a fungicide only if pustules are widespread on young plants.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids and sow early.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply a foliar fungicide at early symptoms on susceptible hybrids.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops, bury residue, use resistant hybrids.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Remove mummified berries and infected leaves; spray mancozeb or myclobutanil from early shoot growth.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Open the canopy by pruning; destroy infected debris.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: No cure. Remove and burn severely affected vines/wood; protect pruning wounds with sealant.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Prune in dry weather, disinfect tools, avoid large pruning wounds.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Spray a copper-based or labelled fungicide; remove infected leaves.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Improve airflow and avoid overhead irrigation.

Grape___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: No cure. Remove infected trees and control the Asian citrus psyllid with approved insecticides. Report to your local agriculture office.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Plant certified disease-free nursery stock; monitor and control psyllids.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays in early spring and a labelled bactericide during the season.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant tolerant varieties; avoid overhead watering; avoid excess nitrogen.

Peach___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray copper-based bactericide; remove badly infected plants.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed, rotate with non-solanaceous crops, avoid working in wet fields.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb at first symptoms; remove infected lower leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops for 2-3 years; avoid plant stress; mulch.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Act fast: remove infected plants and apply a labelled fungicide (e.g. metalaxyl/mancozeb or copper). Do not compost infected material.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use certified seed tubers, hill soil well, avoid overhead irrigation.

Potato___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Raspberry___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Soybean___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray sulfur, neem oil or potassium bicarbonate; remove heavily infected leaves.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Space plants, plant in sun, choose resistant varieties.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Remove infected leaves; apply a labelled fungicide (e.g. captan) if severe.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Use clean plants, renovate beds after harvest, avoid overhead watering.

Strawberry___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray copper-based bactericide; remove infected leaves.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use clean seed, rotate crops, avoid handling wet plants.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove affected lower leaves; apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb or copper fungicide.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch, stake plants, rotate crops, water at the base.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants; apply a labelled fungicide (copper or chlorothalonil) immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid leaf wetness; use resistant varieties; improve ventilation.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Reduce humidity and increase ventilation; apply a labelled fungicide (chlorothalonil or copper).
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Prune lower leaves, avoid overhead watering, use resistant varieties.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves; apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb or copper fungicide.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch, avoid wetting foliage.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Spray insecticidal soap, neem oil or a labelled miticide; wash leaves with water.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Keep plants well watered; encourage natural predators.

Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply a labelled fungicide (chlorothalonil/azoxystrobin); remove infected leaves.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Improve airflow, rotate crops, avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants; control whiteflies with sticky traps, neem oil or approved insecticides.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use virus-resistant varieties, reflective mulch, and insect-proof nets in nurseries.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants; disinfect hands and tools.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use certified seed, resistant varieties; do not smoke/handle tobacco near plants.

Tomato___healthy.treatment: Plant looks healthy. No treatment needed.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Water at the base, keep good spacing and airflow, rotate crops, and scout weekly.
